test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.**

She has a __penchant__ for art and craft.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. '**hatred**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and **marked option**:

 
 
• Penchant- a liking for or a habit of doing something, especially something that other people might not like. (कुछ करने की आदत या पसंद, विशेष रूप से ऐसा कुछ जो अन्य लोगों को पसंद न हो।)
 
• Hatred- an extremely strong feeling of dislike. (नापसंदगी की एक बेहद मजबूत भावना।)
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other **given options**:
 
 
• **Fear- **to be worried or frightened that something bad might happen or might have happened. (चिंतित या भयभीत होना कि कुछ बुरा हो सकता है या हो सकता है।)
 
• **Joy- **great happiness. (महान खुशी।)
 
• **Anxiety- **an uncomfortable feeling of nervousness or worry about something that is happening or might happen in the future. (घबराहट की एक असहज भावना या जो कुछ हो रहा है या भविष्य में हो सकता है उसके बारे में चिंता करना।)
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that ‘penchant’ and ‘hatred’ are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.
